text:
lena: FYI planning a small docs + SDK release tomorrow 09:00 PT: standardize example credentials and introduce an example-credential rotation policy. Details below.

sam: What exactly are we changing?

lena: Two things: (1) remove hard-coded example API keys from public snippets and replace with `RWI_EXAMPLE_KEY` env var pattern in all examples; (2) publish an "example credential rotation" guidance with a 30-day recommended rotation cadence for any example keys used in demos. No runtime behavior change.

ellie: Will this break any CI or demo notebooks?

lena: We added a small helper in SDKs `rwi.examples.load_example_key()` that falls back to a local file `~/.rwi/examples.key` or env var. It will log a NOTICE when using a bundled example key. Teams should update CI to set `RWI_EXAMPLE_KEY`. We'll keep backward compatibility for 90 days for repos that still have embedded keys.

marco: Any legal/privacy checks?

legal: Reviewed. Good to remove static keys. The rotation guidance should include recommended scope and minimal privileges. Also add a snippet explaining never to use production keys in examples.

docs-bot: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/599 "docs: example credential rotation + env var pattern". Adds `recipes/credential-rotation.md` and a linter rule EXAMPLE_CREDENTIAL_IN_CODE (docs-511).

ellie: Linter schedule? We need to avoid breaking many repos.

lena: docs-511 will be WARN for 21 days then ERROR. We also added `rwi-cli check-examples --find-keys` to help teams identify embedded keys. Shipping in `rwi-cli@1.1.0`.

sam: Good. Can we also include a short migrate script to safely remove keys and replace with env var placeholders?

lena: Yes: `rwi-cli scrub-keys --dry-run|--fix` will replace detected keys in fenced code blocks with `RWI_EXAMPLE_KEY` and add a note comment. It will create a git branch when `--fix` is used.

release-bot: Draft release note: "Docs: remove hard-coded example keys, add example credential rotation recipe, rwi-cli helpers, docs linter rule docs-511 (21d WARN -> ERROR)." Internal checklist: https://internal.redwood/releases/checklists/examples-credential-rotation

marco: I'll run the checker across partner repos tonight.

ellie: Thanks, everyone "
